name: nft-accept-prefix-covers-peer
description: an accept on the covering prefix, with the later drop never reached
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.0/24 accept

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
